description: This file contains functions for routing requests between teams based on tags, including validation of deployment tags, filtering deployments by tags, and extracting tags from request metadata. It is part of a larger system for managing deployment routing logic in a machine learning or API deployment context.

methods.name: is_valid_deployment_tag
methods.description: Checks if any request tags are present in deployment tags.

methods.name: get_deployments_for_tag
methods.description: Filters healthy deployments based on request tags and default tags, returning appropriate deployment list.

methods.name: _get_tags_from_request_kwargs
methods.description: Extracts tags from request keyword arguments based on specified metadata variable name.
